thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired -> SEV2: EMBED_QUEUE_5XX spike in us-west. Trigger: >15% 5xx over 5m. Pager: oncall-us. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

devon: oncall here — claiming. I'll start triage. @maria-g FYI for CS.

devon: quick initial glance — tailing embedder logs, seeing burst of 504/502 from redis-kv and lots of evictions. Running local tail now.

samir: if redis is the culprit I can flip routing to dedicated pool in us-east as a temporary fallback. Want me to proceed?

devon: yes please, do the fallback. Also enabling a prefix cache bypass to reduce KV load: `feature.toggle('prefix_cache_bypass', true)`

oncall-eu: taking over for a warm handoff at 03:52 UTC — will coordinate the cutover and keep the bridge open. devon drop me the runbook link and the quick commands.

devon: runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/embeds-queue-failure. Quick commands: 
```
# reroute traffic
redwoodctl route set --service embeds --pool dedicated-us-east --weight 0.6
# scale pool
redwoodctl pool scale --pool dedicated-us-east --replicas 4
```

oncall-eu: applied route change and kicked off scale. Dashboard shows 5xx dropping to ~4% after ~30s :chart_with_downwards_trend: — continue to monitor.

maria-g: CS notified top impacted customers with: "We're routing traffic to a fallback pool and investigating root cause. ETA ~15m." Will post updates to the customer thread. :email: :phone:

samir: also added a temporary proxy-level outbound cap to reduce backpressure: `X-Embed-Rate-Limit: 18/s` (temporary).

devon: digging into infra logs — redis node r5-12 shows OOM kill around 03:50 UTC, syslog excerpt: 
```
Mar 10 03:50:12 r5-12 kernel: oom-killer invoked
process redis pid=8452 oom_score_adj=0
```
This aligns with eviction/backpressure theory.

oncall-eu: handoff notes: devon -> oncall-eu at 03:55 UTC. Current status: routing fallback active, scaled dedicated pool, proxy rate-limit in place, 5xx trend improving. I'm owning until infra confirms root fix.

devon: thanks — I'll stand down from active mitigation and keep monitoring. Ping me if it regresses.

incidentbot: Update: incident auto-ack by devon. Incident owner set to oncall-eu. Tags: redis, routing-fallback, customer-impact. INC12345 created for tracking.

maria-g: logging customer update in Ops and INC12345. Will coordinate postmortem comms and a brief status note for affected customers. :memo:
